description.zh: 跟随同一片光球，观察亮颗粒与暗边界；这是加速的对流表面示意。
description.en: Follow one photospheric region: bright granules and darker boundaries illustrate accelerated convection.

text.zh: 太阳自己发光，周围的行星反射它的光。
text.en: The Sun emits its own light; planets reflect it.

text.zh: 稀薄的外层大气向太空伸展。日珥是受磁场约束的等离子体。
text.en: The thin outer atmosphere extends into space. Magnetic fields support the plasma in prominences.

text.zh: 明暗颗粒与对流有关；黑子比周围冷，却依然非常热。
text.en: Granulation is associated with convection. Sunspots are cooler than their surroundings but still extremely hot.

text.zh: 跟随同一片光球，观察亮颗粒与暗边界；这是加速的对流表面示意。
text.en: Follow one photospheric region: bright granules and darker boundaries illustrate accelerated convection.

description.zh: 盆地中的撞击坑与岩屑。局部起伏为区域地貌重建，不是实测高度图。
description.en: Craters and debris within the basin. Local relief is a regional reconstruction, not a measured elevation map.

text.zh: 我们从太空靠近水星。
text.en: We approach Mercury from space.

text.zh: 几乎没有大气散射出蓝天。
text.en: There is almost no atmosphere to scatter a blue sky.

text.zh: 撞击坑的边缘隆起，坑里有阴影。
text.en: Impact rims rise above the ground and cast shadows.

text.zh: 盆地中的撞击坑与岩屑。局部起伏为区域地貌重建，不是实测高度图。
text.en: Craters and debris within the basin. Local relief is a regional reconstruction, not a measured elevation map.

description.zh: 从浓厚云层进入火山地貌示意。地面形态主要依据雷达推断。
description.en: Descend through thick clouds toward illustrative volcanic relief, inferred primarily from radar.

text.zh: 可见光下，厚云遮住地面。
text.en: Visible light reveals clouds that hide the ground.

text.zh: 雾越来越浓，远处难以看清。
text.en: Haze thickens and limits the view.

text.zh: 穿过云层后，仍有浓厚的大气。
text.en: Below the clouds, a dense atmosphere remains.

text.zh: 从浓厚云层进入火山地貌示意。地面形态主要依据雷达推断。
text.en: Descend through thick clouds toward illustrative volcanic relief, inferred primarily from radar.

description.zh: 从北非沙漠上空接近，沙丘的脊线与裸岩逐渐清晰。
description.en: Approach the North African desert as dune crests and exposed rock become clearer.

text.zh: 从太空能分清大陆、海洋和白云。
text.en: From space we can distinguish land, oceans and clouds.

text.zh: 大气边缘出现薄薄的蓝色光晕。
text.en: A thin blue glow appears along the atmospheric limb.

text.zh: 从北非沙漠上空接近，沙丘的脊线与裸岩逐渐清晰。
text.en: Approach the North African desert as dune crests and exposed rock become clearer.

text.zh: 从北非沙漠上空接近，沙丘的脊线与裸岩逐渐清晰。
text.en: Approach the North African desert as dune crests and exposed rock become clearer.

description.zh: 固定在冰盖内部，靠近白色冰雪和冰面纹理；起伏经过放大。
description.en: Approach the ice-sheet interior, with snow, ice and exaggerated surface relief.

name.zh: 南极冰盖 · 春季示意

description.zh: 南极的季节性干冰霜层夹有水冰和尘埃。春季干冰升华，冰面出现侵蚀纹理与深色尘埃；此处固定为春季示意。
description.en: Seasonal dry-ice frost contains water ice and dust. Spring sublimation exposes erosion textures and dark dust; this scene holds a spring state.

text.zh: 火星有深浅不同的地表区域。
text.en: Mars has light and dark surface regions.

text.zh: 稀薄大气中的尘埃影响天空颜色。
text.en: Dust in its thin atmosphere affects the sky color.

text.zh: 南极的季节性干冰霜层夹有水冰和尘埃。春季干冰升华，冰面出现侵蚀纹理与深色尘埃；此处固定为春季示意。
text.en: Seasonal dry-ice frost contains water ice and dust. Spring sublimation exposes erosion textures and dark dust; this scene holds a spring state.

text.zh: 南极的季节性干冰霜层夹有水冰和尘埃。春季干冰升华，冰面出现侵蚀纹理与深色尘埃；此处固定为春季示意。
text.en: Seasonal dry-ice frost contains water ice and dust. Spring sublimation exposes erosion textures and dark dust; this scene holds a spring state.

description.zh: 从赤道附近的峡谷区域下降，始终沿着同一条谷地观察台地、崖壁和沙尘。
description.en: Descend over an equatorial canyon, following the same valley between layered cliffs, plateaus and dust.

text.zh: 从赤道附近的峡谷区域下降，始终沿着同一条谷地观察台地、崖壁和沙尘。
text.en: Descend over an equatorial canyon, following the same valley between layered cliffs, plateaus and dust.

description.zh: 跟随大红斑的示意中心，观察云丝绕行与不同高度的云。风暴经度随时间变化，此处固定在模型坐标。
description.en: Follow the modeled storm center and clouds at different heights. Storm longitude changes with time; this is a fixed model coordinate.

text.zh: 条纹来自大气里的云带。
text.en: The stripes are atmospheric cloud bands.

text.zh: 跟随大红斑的示意中心，观察云丝绕行与不同高度的云。风暴经度随时间变化，此处固定在模型坐标。
text.en: Follow the modeled storm center and clouds at different heights. Storm longitude changes with time; this is a fixed model coordinate.

text.zh: 眼前越来越多是云与雾。
text.en: Clouds and haze increasingly fill the view.

text.zh: 跟随大红斑的示意中心，观察云丝绕行与不同高度的云。风暴经度随时间变化，此处固定在模型坐标。
text.en: Follow the modeled storm center and clouds at different heights. Storm longitude changes with time; this is a fixed model coordinate.

description.zh: 中央气旋周围还有各自旋转的气旋，云丝围绕多个中心弯曲。位置与速度是示意。
description.en: Several separate vortices surround a central cyclone. Cloud filaments curl around multiple centers; positions and speeds are illustrative.

text.en: The stripes are atmospheric cloud bands.

description.zh: 六边形是一圈急流的形状，中心还有极地旋涡。沿同一区域进入层叠云雾。
description.en: The hexagon traces a jet surrounding a polar vortex. Follow this region into layered cloud and haze.

text.zh: 环由许多颗粒组成，不是坚固圆盘。
text.en: Rings consist of many particles, not a solid disc.

text.zh: 我们朝星球靠近，没有在环上着陆。
text.en: We approach the planet without landing on the rings.

text.zh: 浅色云带逐渐充满视野。
text.en: Pale cloud bands gradually fill the view.

text.zh: 六边形是一圈急流的形状，中心还有极地旋涡。沿同一区域进入层叠云雾。
text.en: The hexagon traces a jet surrounding a polar vortex. Follow this region into layered cloud and haze.

description.zh: 淡黄色云带沿纬度方向错动，近景是云和雾，没有可站立的地面。
description.en: Pale cloud bands drift at different rates. The close view contains clouds and haze, with no solid ground.

text.zh: 我们朝星球靠近，没有在环上着陆。

description.zh: 较低对比度的云带隐藏在霾层中，靠近后能看见稀疏的明亮云团。
description.en: Low-contrast bands lie beneath haze, with sparse bright clouds becoming clearer on approach.

text.zh: 天王星的自转轴倾斜得很厉害。
text.en: Uranus has an extreme axial tilt.

text.zh: 甲烷影响它的可见光颜色。
text.en: Methane affects its visible color.

text.zh: 微弱云纹帮助我们发现大气的运动。
text.en: Subtle streaks help reveal atmospheric motion.

text.zh: 较低对比度的云带隐藏在霾层中，靠近后能看见稀疏的明亮云团。
text.en: Low-contrast bands lie beneath haze, with sparse bright clouds becoming clearer on approach.

name.zh: 暗斑与明亮云团 · 示意
name.en: Dark vortex and bright clouds · illustration

description.zh: 跟随一个代表性暗旋涡和附近的明亮云团。暗斑会出现和消失，此处不是实时天气。
description.en: Follow a representative dark vortex and nearby bright clouds. Dark spots form and disappear; this is not live weather.

text.zh: 颜色示意采用较淡的蓝绿色。
text.en: The illustration uses a relatively pale blue-green color.

text.zh: 亮云与较暗云层形成对比。
text.en: Bright clouds contrast with darker layers.

text.zh: 云带运动被加快，方便观察。
text.en: Cloud motion is accelerated for observation.

text.zh: 跟随一个代表性暗旋涡和附近的明亮云团。暗斑会出现和消失，此处不是实时天气。
text.en: Follow a representative dark vortex and nearby bright clouds. Dark spots form and disappear; this is not live weather.

description.zh: 坑壁、坑底与岩屑始终属于同一片撞击地貌。高度与细节为示意。
description.en: Crater walls, floor and debris stay within the same impact landscape. Heights and details are illustrative.

text.zh: 月球绕地球运行，也随地球一起绕太阳。
text.en: The Moon orbits Earth and accompanies it around the Sun.

text.zh: 没有浓厚的大气挡住视线。
text.en: No thick atmosphere obscures the view.

text.zh: 撞击坑与较暗平原形态不同。
text.en: Impact craters differ from the darker plains.

text.zh: 坑壁、坑底与岩屑始终属于同一片撞击地貌。高度与细节为示意。
text.en: Crater walls, floor and debris stay within the same impact landscape. Heights and details are illustrative.

description.zh: 穿过橙色霾层，接近液态烃湖泊和水冰组成的岸边。岸线细节为示意。
description.en: Pass through orange haze toward a hydrocarbon sea and water-ice terrain. Shoreline details are illustrative.

text.zh: 浓雾遮住土卫六的地貌。
text.en: Thick haze hides Titan’s terrain.

text.zh: 大气使远处景物逐渐模糊。
text.en: Atmosphere makes distant features increasingly hazy.

text.zh: 极区有探测器发现的湖海。
text.en: Spacecraft have detected lakes and seas in polar regions.

text.zh: 穿过橙色霾层，接近液态烃湖泊和水冰组成的岸边。岸线细节为示意。
text.en: Pass through orange haze toward a hydrocarbon sea and water-ice terrain. Shoreline details are illustrative.
